plain_summary: The exact wall census reproduces: 1,152 guard-passing shortcut-free cuts, all adding crossing links under the stated block labels, none thinning the seam. Four fresh paired growth runs to 65,536 sites give seam-preference stretch changes of +0.017, 0, −0.014 and +0.018, well below the proposed +0.05 benefit. Locked-link fractions remain about 6%. This supports the tested route's negative result without proving a universal impossibility. The separate claim that every preference lowers stretch under carrier supply remains unestablished.
